glosses: performance (amount of useful work accomplished by someone or something)

examples.text: Não estou satisfeito com seu desempenho.
examples.en: I'm not satisfied with your performance.

examples.text: Fiquei impressionado com o desempenho de Tom.
examples.en: I was impressed by Tom's performance.

examples.text: A crítica do desempenho do ator foi justa.
examples.en: The criticism of the actor's performance was just.
